title: Eureka Service Discovery
description: Learn service discovery at the developer level using Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka: build a Eureka Server, register Spring Boot services as Eureka clients, discover logical services without hardcoded instance addresses, work with multiple instances, and understand health/lease behavior and client-side load balancing while preparing for Spring Cloud Gateway.

nodes.label: The Discovery Problem & Eureka Concepts
nodes.description: Understand why hardcoded service locations become fragile as services restart, move, and scale, what a service registry does, what Eureka specifically is (a registration server plus client), and what Eureka deliberately is not — an API gateway, a business database, or a message broker.
